label: Mill defended and refined Bentham's principle of utility, introducing qualitative distinctions between higher intellectual and lower bodily pleasures
description: John Stuart Mill took up the concept of "Principle of Utility" and systematized its implications for later thought.
dialecticalTension: Dialectical engagement with the core claims and paradoxes of "Principle of Utility".
historicalContext: Inherited and re-evaluated during the 19th Century Divergences.

label: Rawls formulated his Theory of Justice as a direct critique of aggregate utilitarianism, arguing justice as fairness cannot sacrifice individual liberty for net pleasure
description: John Rawls formulated a fundamental critique of "Principle of Utility", challenging its coherence and proposing an alternative model.
dialecticalTension: Dialectical engagement with the core claims and paradoxes of "Principle of Utility".
historicalContext: Inherited and re-evaluated during the Contemporary & Post-Structural.
